title: Fail-Closed Multi-Tenant Authorization Policy Engine
description: Evaluate composable authorization policies without IDOR, confused-deputy, wildcard, or deny-precedence failures.
prompt: Implement `authorize(request: dict, policies: list[dict]) -> bool` using only the Python standard library. A request contains non-empty `subject_id`, `tenant_id`, `resource_tenant_id`, `roles` (list of strings), `action`, `resource`, and `context` (dict). Immediately deny malformed requests and every request whose `tenant_id != resource_tenant_id`. Each policy must contain `effect` (`allow` or `deny`), `tenant`, and non-empty lists `roles`, `actions`, and `resources`; optional `conditions` is a dict. If any policy is malformed, fail closed for the whole evaluation. A policy matches when its tenant equals the request tenant or `*`; at least one role matches (`*` allowed); action and resource match at least one case-sensitive shell-style pattern using `fnmatch.fnmatchcase`; and every condition matches the same key in `request['context']`. A scalar condition requires equality; a list condition accepts membership. Matching deny overrides every allow. Return true only if at least one allow matches and no deny matches. Do not mutate inputs. Provide only valid Python code in one fenced block.
test_code:
base_request = {
    'subject_id': 'u-1',
    'tenant_id': 't-1',
    'resource_tenant_id': 't-1',
    'roles': ['analyst'],
    'action': 'invoice:read',
    'resource': 'invoice:2026:INV-7',
    'context': {'region': 'ID', 'mfa': True},
}
policies = [
    {'effect': 'allow', 'tenant': 't-1', 'roles': ['analyst'], 'actions': ['invoice:read'], 'resources': ['invoice:2026:*'], 'conditions': {'region': ['ID', 'SG'], 'mfa': True}},
    {'effect': 'deny', 'tenant': 't-1', 'roles': ['*'], 'actions': ['invoice:delete'], 'resources': ['invoice:*']},
]
assert authorize(base_request, policies) is True

no_mfa = {**base_request, 'context': {'region': 'ID', 'mfa': False}}
assert authorize(no_mfa, policies) is False

delete_request = {**base_request, 'action': 'invoice:delete'}
allow_delete = {'effect': 'allow', 'tenant': 't-1', 'roles': ['analyst'], 'actions': ['invoice:*'], 'resources': ['invoice:*']}
assert authorize(delete_request, policies + [allow_delete]) is False

cross_tenant = {**base_request, 'resource_tenant_id': 't-2'}
assert authorize(cross_tenant, [{'effect': 'allow', 'tenant': '*', 'roles': ['*'], 'actions': ['*'], 'resources': ['*']}]) is False

wrong_case = {**base_request, 'action': 'Invoice:Read'}
assert authorize(wrong_case, policies) is False

assert authorize(base_request, policies + [{'effect': 'permit', 'tenant': 't-1', 'roles': ['*'], 'actions': ['*'], 'resources': ['*']}]) is False
assert authorize(base_request, policies + [{'effect': 'allow', 'tenant': 't-1', 'roles': [], 'actions': ['*'], 'resources': ['*']}]) is False
assert authorize({'tenant_id': 't-1'}, policies) is False
assert authorize(base_request, []) is False

request_copy = {**base_request, 'roles': list(base_request['roles']), 'context': dict(base_request['context'])}
policies_copy = [dict(p) for p in policies]
authorize(base_request, policies)
assert base_request == request_copy
assert policies == policies_copy

print('Multi-tenant authorization tests passed.')
